title: DF-VERIFY/1 — receipt/v1 profile
description: A signed, timestamped record of an arbitrary asserted claim or datum — the audit artifact for 'what an AI was told (or asserted), and when.' The detached Ed25519 signature covers the whole object except its `signature` field, canonicalized json-sorted-compact (see https://dynamicfeed.ai/standard). Verifies identically to awareness/v1.

issuer.description: domain of the signing issuer, e.g. dynamicfeed.ai

issued_at.description: the moment the claim was asserted/recorded

data.description: the asserted claim or datum — any JSON value the issuer is putting on the record
